crossRefs.note: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one…

translations.web: On the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
translations.bsb: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
translations.kjv: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
translations.asv: on the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
